name: Alex Johnson
bio: Met in university during freshman year. We bonded over late-night study sessions and now share a love for hiking and craft beer.

name: Sarah Chen
bio: My first manager at the company. She taught me everything about product management. We still catch up over coffee every few weeks.

name: Marcus Williams
bio: Grew up on the same street. We built forts in backyards and now build startups. Despite the distance, he's still my go-to person for big life decisions.

name: Priya Patel
bio: Study abroad roommate in Barcelona. We explored 8 countries together in one semester and have been inseparable travel partners ever since.

name: David Kim
bio: Met at a tech conference three years ago. We now work out together every Tuesday and Thursday morning before the workday starts.

name: Emma Rodriguez
bio: Childhood best friend who feels more like a sister. We drifted apart during college but reconnected at a mutual friend's wedding and never looked back.

name: Liam O'Brien
bio: Band member from my local jam sessions. We play guitar together every Sunday and he pushes me to get better at songwriting.

name: Aisha Okonkwo
bio: Neighbor who turned into a dear friend through our monthly book club. She has incredible taste in literature and always challenges my thinking.

name: James Park
bio: My co-founder from a startup we built together during senior year. Even though the startup didn't last, our friendship became one of my strongest.

name: Nina Johansson
bio: Designer I collaborated with on a year-long project. Her attention to detail and creative vision completely changed how I approach problem-solving.
